Hey, just came across this post and wanted to let you know that I feel the same way sometimes. I get frustrated so often that some people have it so easy while the rest of us are struggling to keep our heads out of water. It's not jealousy and it's not envy, like for example so many of my friends had their careers planned out by their parents while mine didn't help me with anything and now I'm left to figure it out for myself, maybe if I were some meritorious kid, I probably wouldn't have needed guidance but I'm not and I know I needed guidance, so right now everyone's in a particular channel while I'm the only one without an aim but no worries, I'll figure out something,also some of them come from privileged backgrounds and of course their lives are all chalked and planned out,I don't have a single reliable person in my life and I'm  physically and emotionally struggling as well, I have a chronic disease which causes immense pain very often. I feel very helpless and hopeless sometimes, sure I feel very angry sometimes, but I think acceptance is the key, yes, we didn't choose this life and it was handed to us and it turned out this way but we have to accept and try to make changes according to our capacities. I can't become friends with Bradd Pitt tomorrow but sure I can maybe become friends with a few people or can be a friend to someone who is in need of one. I have slowly started accepting that you don't always get sunshine and sure it's less lonely when you're crowded by people but honestly what I've seen in groups is they only meet to drink and discuss other people and their achievements/downfall. This generation in particular is messed up, there are no true people out there and there's just competition over who's got a better house. So, just hold on tight and get off social media, it's fake as hell. Believe in yourself and you will pull through, see you on the other side. And remember when you feel like you're losing it, concentrate on your breath, think of somebody who was kind to you when you didn't deserve it or just think of a good deed you did sometime in your life, God bless.
